Method of Attack: Downgrade critical Windows components such as DLLs, drivers, and the NT kernel to older vulnerable versions without detection
Bypass Windows Digital Signature Enforcement (DSE) to load unsigned kernel drivers
Revert patched Windows modules (e.g., ci.dll) to unpatched versions to enable exploits like ItsNotASecurityBoundary
Attack Vector: Exploitation of downgrade attacks on Windows components
Modification of system files by triggering page faults to bypass file immutability protections
Use of custom tool to swap in vulnerable component versions
